PRINCIPAL

Special Branch S.2. XXXXXX
December 14, 32.

Case against Lee S... (李叔明) accountant of
the Kwang Lung (廣倫) bookstore.

(批：On the authority
of D.B.Ross.)

Lee Son Ping (李松明), who was arrested on October 1
in connection with a raid on the Kwang Lung (廣倫) Book Store,
No.1 So Hong Li (宝源里), Des Voeux Road, where a large
quantity of pro-communist books was seized, appeared before
court on December 7, when he was acquitted but the
reactionary books seized were ordered to be confiscated.

In consequence of the opinion of the Acting Judicial
Advocate in connection with the prosecution of booksellers
selling anti-Government books as contained in the memo. of
the Officer i/c Special Branch of October 22, 1932, a copy of
which is attached, I wish to state that the judgment in this
case is in all flush with the terms of the memo.. While it
can be reasonably believed that the accused had knowledge of the
contents of the reactionary books in the shop where he was
employed as accountant, the Judicial Police are not in a
position to state definitely that he knowingly and wilfully
propagated doctrine contrary to the people's Three Principles.
Moreover, the accused even denied of having an opportunity
to read the books. I, therefore, am of the opinion that the
evidence in our possession is insufficient to proceed further
against the accused.

(SIGNED) D.B.Ross.
D. I.
Jaquez

1932年12月14日。

针对广伦（Kwang Lung）书店会计李叔明（Lee S...）的案件。

（批注：经 D.B.Ross 授权。）

李松明（Lee Son Ping）因10月1日参与搜查德辅道（Des Voeux Road）宝源里（So Hong Li）1号广伦（Kwang Lung）书店一案而被捕，该次行动中查获了大量亲共书籍。他于12月7日出庭受审，当时被判无罪，但所查获的反动书籍被下令没收。

鉴于代理司法顾问就起诉售卖反政府书籍的书商一事所提出的意见——该意见载于1932年10月22日特别处主管警官的备忘录中，副本附后——我愿指出，本案的判决完全符合该备忘录的条款。虽然可以合理地相信，被告作为受雇于该店的会计，知晓店内反动书籍的内容，但司法警察无法明确断定他是明知且故意传播违背人民三民主义的学说。此外，被告甚至否认曾有机会阅读这些书籍。因此，我认为我方掌握的证据不足以对被告采取进一步行动。

（签名）D.B.Ross.

To All Sections of the Special Branch:-

Prosecution of Bookstores Selling
Anti-Government Literature.

The following written opinion of the Municipal
Advocate concerning the prosecution of bookstores which
sell anti-Government literature is circulated for
information of members of staff of all Sections of the
Special Branch:-

"In case of Bookshops selling anti-
"Government books, no charge should be preferred
"against the shop proprietor or manager unless
"the Police can prove that the accused knowingly
"and intentionally propagates doctrines contrary to
"People's Three Principles. Failure to examine books
"by the proprietor or manager before the same is
"offered for sale is not sufficient to constitute
"an offence.

King S. Kum,
A/M.A.

In executing warrants issued by the Shanghai
Special District Court at the instance of the Chinese
Authorities, it will not be necessary to observe the terms of the
above advice.

(Signed) T. P. Givens

SHEET 4

Proceedings:-, Mr. Lea appeared for the police.
Messrs. Kan Vung Han, Tuen Yong n, Kan Ling for the accused.

accused Lee oh Ming:- I am an employed at the Kwong
Lung Book Store.

Mr. Lea:- At 4.45.pm. 18.1.1932, acting on the author-
ity of a search warrant issued by this court, the police raided No.
18 Lao Kong Li, Chekiang Road, and seized many kinds of communistic
literature, and found that the accused is responsible for the book
store. The accused was brought to the court on the 12.10.1932, and
charged with possession of communistic literature. The books have
been sent to the District Government for examination. May I have
the list of the books for perusal? (list handed to Mr. Lea).

J.P.C.17:- At 4.45.pm. 18.10.1932, we went to No.18
Lao Kong Li Chekiang Road, the Kwong Lung Book Store. The accused
was the only person in the store when we entered, and when he was
questioned he stated that he was an accountant, and that he would
be responsible for everything. He refused to tell the police the
name of the proprietor. The accused was questioned in the station,
and he stated that he is only the accountant and that the store was
owned by others. A book shewing the names of shareholders was also
seized (produced).

Accused:- I came to Shanghai in September, 1929. I
am an accountant at the Kwong Lung Bookstore for $30.00 per month.
A man named Mien Tien King used to be the proprietor but he trans-
ferred the store to Lee Ngoh Ming. This store has a capital of
$5000.00. I only attend to the account books, I do not publish any
books.

SUMMING UP

Decision:- Pleadings concluded. Remanded until 7.12.1932 at 1.30.pm.,
for Judgment.

C.N.R.

诉讼过程：Lea 先生代表警方出庭。
Kan Vung Han、Tuen Yong n、Kan Ling 诸位先生代表被告。

被告 Lee oh Ming：我是广隆书局的雇员。

Lea 先生：1932年10月18日下午4时45分，依据本院签发的搜查令，警方搜查了浙江路保康里18号，查获多种共产主义文献，并查明被告对该书局负责。被告于1932年10月12日被提审，被控持有共产主义文献。相关书籍已送交区政府审查。可否将书单呈阅？（书单已递交给 Lea 先生）。

J.P.C.17：1932年10月18日下午4时45分，我们前往浙江路保康里18号广隆书局。当我们进入时，店内只有被告一人，经讯问，他声称自己是会计，并对一切事务负责。他拒绝向警方透露店主姓名。被告在捕房接受讯问时称，他只是会计，书局归他人所有。另查获一本显示股东姓名的账簿（已出示）。

被告：我于1929年9月来到上海。我在广隆书局担任会计，月薪30.00元。一位名叫 Mien Tien King 的人曾是店主，但他已将书局转让给 Lee Ngoh Ming。该店资本为5000.00元。我只负责账目，不出版任何书籍。

总结

裁决：辩论终结。还押候判，直至1932年12月7日下午1时30分宣判。

C.N.R.

The February Revolution created serious chaos among the ruling
classes. At the battle front the troops suffered defeats,whilst
in the country,especially at St Petersburg a shortage of bread
occurred. At that time the need for bread was an urgent
problem confrontingthe masses. On March 18th,thefemale workers
in St Petersburg,after leaving their ories,staged
demonstrations and processions in obs .ce of the International
Women's Day. Duringthese movements they cameinto conflict with
the Police,whereupon these latter fired on the female masses
which resulted on many of the women being killed. On the
following day a general strike was declared throughout the city
of St Petersburg and the feelings of the masses rose to the
highest pitch. On the fourth day of the strike,the troops
stationed in St Petersburg went over to the side of the workers
and even staged riots of labourers and soldiers. The February
Revolution was thus staged without much bloodshed.
With the downfall of "Czardom" as a result of the
February Revolution,Soviet rule was established at St Petersburg.
All the soldiers and labourers were under the command of the
Soviet,which,at that time,was under the guidance of the
Menshevik and the Social Revolutionary Parties. These two latter
parties were not willing that the proletarians should rule the
country.
At that time the power of the Bolsheviks was very feeble,
important leaders of the Bolsheviks,such as Lenin,Gevenoff etc
were residents in foreign countries. Consequently the February
Revolution was not under the leadership of the Bolsheviks.
In April,Lenin returned from Switzerland and under his
leadership the Bolsheviks were then able to possess a united
and proper "route". On the day following his arrival at St
Petersburg,Lenin attended a mass meeting at which he announced
his famous "April General Principles",which contained the
following important points:-
(1) The World War was Imperialistic
in nature for the purpose of encroaching on and oppressing
other peoples.
(2) The proletarians and the peasants

二月革命在统治阶级中造成了严重的混乱。在前线，军队遭受失败，而在国内，特别是在圣彼得堡，出现了面包短缺。当时，面包需求是群众面临的一个紧迫问题。3月18日，圣彼得堡的女工们在离开工厂后，借国际妇女节之机举行示威和游行。在这些运动中，她们与警察发生冲突，随后警察向女性群众开枪，导致许多妇女被杀。次日，圣彼得堡全市宣布总罢工，群众情绪高涨至顶点。罢工的第四天，驻守圣彼得堡的军队倒向工人一边，甚至发生了劳工和士兵的暴动。因此，二月革命是在没有过多流血的情况下进行的。
随着二月革命导致“沙皇制度”的垮台，圣彼得堡建立了苏维埃政权。所有士兵和劳工都受苏维埃指挥，而当时的苏维埃受孟什维克和社会革命党的指导。这两个政党不愿意让无产阶级统治国家。
当时布尔什维克的力量非常微弱，列宁、Gevenoff（音译）等布尔什维克重要领导人居住在国外。因此，二月革命并非在布尔什维克的领导下进行。
四月，列宁从瑞士回国，在他的领导下，布尔什维克得以拥有统一且正确的“路线”。抵达圣彼得堡的第二天，列宁参加了一次群众大会，会上他宣布了著名的“四月提纲”，其中包含以下要点：-
(1) 世界大战具有帝国主义性质，目的是侵略和压迫其他民族。
(2) 无产阶级和农民应夺取统治权，不应允许资本家组建临时政府。
(3) 不协助或不信任临时政府。
(4) 苏维埃应为统治机构。
(5) 应建立苏维埃共和国。

(7) 全国所有银行应予没收，并在政府控制下组织联合银行。

(8) 所有重要工厂应置于劳工监督之下。
(9) 党名应改为共产党。
(10) 应重建无产阶级国际，并称为第二共产国际

然而，随着战争宣言的发表，各国社会党内的机会主义领导人背离了群众，公开改变态度，协助他们的资本主义政府。

各国大多数年轻士兵战死沙场，那些能被驱赶上战场的人则被征召入伍。就这样，许多非洲殖民地的本土部队被命令参战。

Raid on bookstore - one arrest
Acting on the authority of a search warrant, the
Municipal Police raided on October 13 the Kwun Lung
Bookstore (昆崙), No.18 Pao King Li (保康里),
Chekiang Road, and seized a large quantity of pro-
communist books comprising forty different kinds. The
accountant named Li Soh Ming (李粹明), who was in
charge at the time of the search, was arrested. He
will appear before Court on October 14.

突袭书店——逮捕一人
依据搜查令的授权，公共租界警务处于10月13日突袭了位于浙江路保康里18号的昆崙书店，缴获大量亲共书籍，共计四十种不同类别。当时负责该店事务的会计师李粹明被捕。他将于10月14日出庭受审。

RECORD OF INVESTIGATION.

At 4.45 p.m. today the 13-10-32 acting on the authority of Search Warrant No.5440, detectives from the Special Branch and Louza Station raided the Hung Lung (崑崙) Bookstore, No.18 Pao hong Li (保康里), Chekiang Road.

A very large quantity of Communistic books were found in each of the 3 rooms of the ground floor. Samples of these will be produced in Court.

Lee Soh Ming (李牧民), the accountant was taken into custody and will be brought before the 2nd Branch Jiangsu High Court tomorrow forenoon when a Writ of Detention will be applied for to enable the books etc. to be thoroughly examined and a comprehensive list made.

Detectives are now posted in the raided premises.

Lee Soh Ling, age 34 and a native of Hupeh states that he is married and lives in the rear room of the bookstore. He is employed as an accountant and has occupied this position since 1931 having been previously employed in the same company on Chungking Road which was subsequently demolished. His salary is $40.00 per month.

The seized books were printed in 1930 by the Tai Ping (太平) Printing Press at Jang Seh Li (辟壽里), Burkill Road; altogether 50 different kinds being printed, a total of 3,000 copies.

The drafts of the books were bought by the manager, Lee Ngoh Ming (李鶴鳴) who sent them to the Tai Ping Press for printing.

今日（1932年10月13日）下午4时45分，依据第5440号搜查令，特务科及老闸捕房的侦探突袭了位于浙江路保康里18号的“崑崙”书店。

在一楼的三个房间内均发现了大量共产主义书籍。这些书籍的样本将在法庭上出示。

会计师李牧民 (Lee Soh Ming) 已被拘捕，并将于明日上午被提解至江苏高等法院第二分院，届时将申请拘留令，以便对书籍等进行彻底检查并编制详细清单。

侦探目前正驻守在被突袭的场所内。

李索林 (Lee Soh Ling)，34岁，湖北籍，称其已婚，居住在书店后屋。他受雇为会计师，自1931年起担任此职，此前曾在重庆路的同一家公司任职，该公司后来被拆除。他的月薪为40.00元。

被查获的书籍于1930年由位于辟壽里 (Jang Seh Li) 伯基尔路 (Burkill Road) 的太平印刷厂印制；共印制了50种不同的书籍，总计3,000册。

书籍的底稿由经理李鹤鸣 (Lee Ngoh Ming) 购买，并由其送往太平印刷厂印制。

at house No. on the 12-1-32 and transcribed by clerk Lih Yung Lai

I am Lee Shih Ming (李敬民), native of Hucheng, Hupeh.
When I was 10 years old, I entered the local primary
school, Hucheng. When I was 15 years old, I married a woman named Chen I (李傅氏). When
I was 19 years old, I went to Wuchang as an apprentice at the
Yue Tai Tobacco Factory, Wuchang. After remaining
there for about 3 or 4 months, I left this employment and
returned to the country. When I was 25 years of age, I went
to Shanghai and got a job as a clerk in the General Staff
Headquarters. I left that job when I was 27 years old, and
then returned to Wuchang. There I got a job as an account-
ant for a bus company outside of the Great East Gate, Wuchang.
When I was 28 years old, I went to Hankow where I was employed
at a dinner party tax accounting office. As this office closed
after half a year, I had to leave there and return to the country
again. I went to Hong Kiang Hsien, when I was 30, I became an
accountant at the Financial Bureau there. 5 months later, owing
to the Director being changed, I had to leave. Then I went to
Hankow where I was an accountant at the Financial Bureau, Hankow
District. On August, 1930, on my friend's recommendation, I
came to Shanghai and entered the Awun Lung Book Store, at Chung-
king Road as an accountant. In 1931, the above store was
removed to 18 Pao Kung Lee off Chekiang Road, owing to the
premises being demolished, and we carried on our business here.
I am working as an accountant with a pay of $40.00 per month
which is paid to me monthly by the Manager Lee Nyoh Ming (李鹤鸣).

本人李敬民，湖北湖城人。十岁时，入湖城当地小学读书。十五岁时，娶妻陈氏（李傅氏）。十九岁时，赴武昌，在武昌月泰烟草厂当学徒。在那里待了约三四个月后，离职回乡。二十五岁时，前往上海，在总司令部参谋处谋得一份书记员的工作。二十七岁时辞去该职，随后返回武昌。在武昌大东门外一家公共汽车公司担任会计。二十八岁时，前往汉口，受雇于一家宴席税会计事务所。因该事务所在半年后关闭，只得离开并再次回乡。三十岁时，前往洪江县，在当地财政局担任会计。五个月后，因局长更迭，不得不离职。随后前往汉口，在汉口地区财政局担任会计。1930 年 8 月，经朋友推荐，来到上海，进入位于重庆路的阿文龙书店担任会计。1931 年，因原址拆迁，上述书店迁至浙江路宝康里 18 号，我们便在此继续经营。本人担任会计，月薪四十元，由经理李鹤鸣（Lee Nyoh Ming）按月支付。
